note: The later bracket. The Board lists every street it had paved in the previous three years with its material, contractor and condition: 'Prairie avenue, from 16th street to 20th street; asphalt. R. F. Conway Co., contractor. In good condition'; 'Prairie avenue, from 20th street to 22d street; asphalt. Barber Asphalt Paving Co., contractor. In good condition'; 'Indiana avenue, from 18th street to 39th street; asphalt. R. F. Conway Co., contractor. Needs repairs'; 'Alley, north and south, between 20th street and 21st street; rock asphalt. Pugh, contractor. Needs repairs' (all P. J. O'Donnell). Read with the lists of 2 November 1903 and 1 December 1904 it dates three things: Prairie 16th-20th was asphalt before and after the scene; Prairie 20th-22nd went from macadam (December 1904) to asphalt between then and November 1906; Indiana Avenue's asphalt and the alley's rock asphalt were finished between November 1903 and November 1906, which brackets 1 July 1904 without deciding it.
what_it_supplies: the material and contractor of Prairie Avenue 16th-20th (asphalt, R. F. Conway Co.)
that Prairie Avenue 20th-22nd, Indiana Avenue 18th-39th and the alley west of Prairie 20th-21st were paved (asphalt, asphalt, rock asphalt) between November 1903 and November 1906
what_it_does_not_supply: which side of 1 July 1904 those three were finished on
